# Jingyue Glass (Wuhan Jingyueda Household Products Co., Ltd.)

> Direct Factory Glassware Manufacturer & Exporter (B2B / OEM / ODM / Private Label)
> Official Website: https://www.jingyueglass.com/
> Inquiries & Quotations: sales@jingyueglass.com | https://www.jingyueglass.com/custom-glassware-quote-checklist

## Core Business Summary
Jingyue Glass manufactures lead-free crystal wine glasses, machine-blown stemware, heavy-base beer steins, crystal whiskey decanters, high-borosilicate mugs, and turnkey wooden gift box sets with odorless EPE pearl cotton inserts. Sourcing channels include commercial hospitality venues, winery tasting rooms, Amazon FBA private label sellers, and corporate gifting distributors.

## Quotation & Commercial Policy
- All customized OEM/ODM glassware orders are quoted on a project basis according to quantity, glass composition, decoration technique (laser engraving, 580°C ceramic decal, gold rim), packaging specification, and destination trade terms (FOB/CIF/DDP).
- Itemized quotations are provided within 1 business hour upon RFQ submission.

## Official Product Catalogs (PDF Downloads)
- [2026 Commercial Hospitality Glassware Collection (PDF, 15 Pages)](https://www.jingyueglass.com/assets/catalogs/jingyue-glass-hospitality-collection-2026.pdf): 33 commercial SKUs with calibrated rack clearance dimensions, carton CBM, and dishwashing durability data.
- [2026 US E-Commerce & Amazon FBA Gift Collection (PDF, 12 Pages)](https://www.jingyueglass.com/assets/catalogs/jingyue-glass-us-ecommerce-gift-catalog-2026.pdf): 8 turnkey gift suites with packaging dimensions in cm/in, gross weights in kg/lb, and odorless EPE pearl cotton inserts.
